decisions.title: Genesis workflow adoption (DECISION-013)
decisions.text: Genesis adopted as the repository-native workflow/control layer. Authoritative decision content: docs/decisions/DECISION-013-genesis-adoption.md. Genesis owns control state only; never restate decision content here.

decisions.title: Retrieval representation direction (DECISION-016)
decisions.text: DECISION-016 replaces DECISION-010's 21-case baseline-retention conclusion. The frozen 46-case evidence supports local dense semantic retrieval as the next separately authorized integration direction; raw intfloat/e5-small-v2 is the leading local candidate. Production retrieval remains unchanged until that future unit validates the integration.

decisions.title: M6 failure-class analysis (DECISION-022)
decisions.text: Failure-class breakdown of the frozen 46 under E5: HIT1 20, RANKING 16, NEAR_MISS 6, DEEP_MISS 4. Ordering inside the top 20 is the dominant failure; deep misses are paraphrase/label cases, not lexical gaps. M6 reopened for exactly one experiment: cross-encoder reranking of the top-20 pool. Hybrid, Top-K and re-chunking not run on this evidence. Authoritative content: docs/decisions/DECISION-022-m6-failure-class-analysis.md

decisions.title: Reranking experiment outcome (DECISION-023)
decisions.text: Cross-encoder reranking of the E5 top-20 (ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2) on the frozen 46: Hit@1 20->21, Hit@5 36->35, MRR 0.5583->0.5652. Failed DECISION-022's pre-registered adoption bar on both conditions; not adopted. Production retrieval remains raw E5 per DECISION-017. EVAL-HYBRID-001 closed as not run: the lexical-class condition in DECISION-022 remains unmet. Authoritative content: docs/decisions/DECISION-023-reranking-experiment-outcome.md
